description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView that implements the LogNode interface to output and format log messages received via the println method. It includes methods for appending log data, formatting log priority levels into strings, and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data and implements the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and appends them to the view, supporting chainable log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log information including priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, then appends it to the LogView. Also forwards the log message to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a non-null string to a StringBuilder with a specified delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
